spans.text: Of course I can.

units.rawText: After pushing the glider to where we first met, I look at the scenery I'd ignored before—as I gaze upon the steep mountainsides, I become increasingly sure that they are the object of this challenge.
units.displayText: After pushing the glider to where we first met, I look at the scenery I'd ignored before—as I gaze upon the steep mountainsides, I become increasingly sure that they are the object of this challenge.

spans.text: After pushing the glider to where we first met, I look at the scenery I'd ignored before—as I gaze upon the steep mountainsides, I become increasingly sure that they are the object of this challenge.

units.rawText: (As I thought, this place looks just like the backdrop of "Flappy Eucharist".)
units.displayText: As I thought, this place looks just like the backdrop of "Flappy Eucharist".

spans.text: As I thought, this place looks just like the backdrop of "Flappy Eucharist".

units.rawText: Professor, over here, over here. I'm ready.
units.displayText: Professor, over here, over here. I'm ready.

spans.text: Professor, over here, over here. I'm ready.

units.rawText: Stand there and help me record my landing site, my gliding path and so on. Don't miss anything out!
units.displayText: Stand there and help me record my landing site, my gliding path and so on. Don't miss anything out!

spans.text: Stand there and help me record my landing site, my gliding path and so on. Don't miss anything out!

units.rawText: Aren't we going to fly it together?
units.displayText: Aren't we going to fly it together?

spans.text: Aren't we going to fly it together?

units.rawText: Test flights are very dangerous, you know! Accidents can happen easily if you're not careful.
units.displayText: Test flights are very dangerous, you know! Accidents can happen easily if you're not careful.

spans.text: Test flights are very dangerous, you know! Accidents can happen easily if you're not careful.

units.rawText: Plus, you're just a lost traveler who was passing by. You shouldn't endanger yourself by taking part in a professional test flight!
units.displayText: Plus, you're just a lost traveler who was passing by. You shouldn't endanger yourself by taking part in a professional test flight!

spans.text: Plus, you're just a lost traveler who was passing by. You shouldn't endanger yourself by taking part in a professional test flight!
(Convince her.)

options.rawText: (Go up there and physically remove her.)
options.displayText: (Go up there and physically remove her.)

spans.text: (Go up there and physically remove her.)

units.rawText: You don't have any actual flight experience, do you, Croquette?
units.displayText: You don't have any actual flight experience, do you, Croquette?

spans.text: You don't have any actual flight experience, do you, Croquette?

units.rawText: Croquette looks away guiltily. I bend down and ruffle her hair.
units.displayText: Croquette looks away guiltily. I bend down and ruffle her hair.

spans.text: Croquette looks away guiltily. I bend down and ruffle her hair.

units.rawText: However, I do. If we go on this flight together, there's a much higher chance of success. And besides... you're just a kid.
units.displayText: However, I do. If we go on this flight together, there's a much higher chance of success. And besides... you're just a kid.

spans.text: However, I do. If we go on this flight together, there's a much higher chance of success. And besides... you're just a kid.

units.rawText: I... Don't look down on me! I'm a professional designer and pilot, you know!
units.displayText: I... Don't look down on me! I'm a professional designer and pilot, you know!

spans.text: I... Don't look down on me! I'm a professional designer and pilot, you know!

units.rawText: Croquette briefly shies away from me as her face turns red before knocking my hand away.
units.displayText: Croquette briefly shies away from me as her face turns red before knocking my hand away.

spans.text: Croquette briefly shies away from me as her face turns red before knocking my hand away.

units.rawText: I step up and wrap my arms around Croquette before lowering her from the glider.
units.displayText: I step up and wrap my arms around Croquette before lowering her from the glider.

spans.text: I step up and wrap my arms around Croquette before lowering her from the glider.

units.rawText: It's better for adults to do test flights. You should keep an eye on the data logs.
units.displayText: It's better for adults to do test flights. You should keep an eye on the data logs.

spans.text: It's better for adults to do test flights. You should keep an eye on the data logs.

units.rawText: (Pouts) Let me down!
units.displayText: (Pouts) Let me down!

spans.text: (Pouts) Let me down!

units.rawText: Humph! I'm an adult too, you know! The uncles and aunties in the village can all vouch for me and I can design something like the Laputa, so stop treating me like a kid.
units.displayText: Humph! I'm an adult too, you know! The uncles and aunties in the village can all vouch for me and I can design something like the Laputa, so stop treating me like a kid.

spans.text: Humph! I'm an adult too, you know! The uncles and aunties in the village can all vouch for me and I can design something like the Laputa, so stop treating me like a kid.

units.rawText: Croquette plants her hands on her hips in annoyance as she glares at me and puffs up her cheeks.
units.displayText: Croquette plants her hands on her hips in annoyance as she glares at me and puffs up her cheeks.

spans.text: Croquette plants her hands on her hips in annoyance as she glares at me and puffs up her cheeks.

units.rawText: Well, it's okay if you want to fly, but we both have to go.
units.displayText: Well, it's okay if you want to fly, but we both have to go.

spans.text: Well, it's okay if you want to fly, but we both have to go.

units.rawText: Say what you want, but I just can't let someone who helped me out take all the risks while I sit back safe and sound.
units.displayText: Say what you want, but I just can't let someone who helped me out take all the risks while I sit back safe and sound.

spans.text: Say what you want, but I just can't let someone who helped me out take all the risks while I sit back safe and sound.
(Agree.)
(Try to persuade her again.)

units.rawText: Mm. Then you have to be good, okay?
units.displayText: Mm. Then you have to be good, okay?

spans.text: Mm. Then you have to be good, okay?

units.rawText: YOU'RE the one who has to be good! Do you really have any piloting experience?
units.displayText: YOU'RE the one who has to be good! Do you really have any piloting experience?

spans.text: YOU'RE the one who has to be good! Do you really have any piloting experience?

units.rawText: Honestly, you don't need to risk yourself for this! If anything goes wrong, just jump off...
units.displayText: Honestly, you don't need to risk yourself for this! If anything goes wrong, just jump off...

spans.text: Honestly, you don't need to risk yourself for this! If anything goes wrong, just jump off...

units.rawText: What you're saying is even more dangerous.
units.displayText: What you're saying is even more dangerous.

spans.text: What you're saying is even more dangerous.

units.rawText: I still think it'd be better if I did it alone...
units.displayText: I still think it'd be better if I did it alone...

spans.text: I still think it'd be better if I did it alone...

units.rawText: Before I can finish speaking, Croquette steps in front of me, her arms crossed in an X.
units.displayText: Before I can finish speaking, Croquette steps in front of me, her arms crossed in an X.

spans.text: Before I can finish speaking, Croquette steps in front of me, her arms crossed in an X.

units.rawText: No! Absolutely not! If you don't agree, then... then I'll sneak out and do a test flight myself in secret!
units.displayText: No! Absolutely not! If you don't agree, then... then I'll sneak out and do a test flight myself in secret!

spans.text: No! Absolutely not! If you don't agree, then... then I'll sneak out and do a test flight myself in secret!

units.rawText: How does that count as secret...
units.displayText: How does that count as secret...

spans.text: How does that count as secret...

units.rawText: In any case, no means no!
units.displayText: In any case, no means no!

spans.text: In any case, no means no!

units.rawText: You're still as stubborn as ever despite becoming smaller.
units.displayText: You're still as stubborn as ever despite becoming smaller.

spans.text: You're still as stubborn as ever despite becoming smaller.

units.rawText: What did you say?
units.displayText: What did you say?

spans.text: What did you say?

units.rawText: Oh, it's nothing. Let's get to work, then.
units.displayText: Oh, it's nothing. Let's get to work, then.

spans.text: Oh, it's nothing. Let's get to work, then.

units.rawText: I scoop up Croquette and we both take our places on the glider. After ensuring everything is ready, we set out in the direction of Pyrewood.
units.displayText: I scoop up Croquette and we both take our places on the glider. After ensuring everything is ready, we set out in the direction of Pyrewood.

spans.text: I scoop up Croquette and we both take our places on the glider. After ensuring everything is ready, we set out in the direction of Pyrewood.

units.rawText: The cool, gentle wind becomes cutting and frigid as we pick up speed, like razors of ice slashing across my face.
units.displayText: The cool, gentle wind becomes cutting and frigid as we pick up speed, like razors of ice slashing across my face.

spans.text: The cool, gentle wind becomes cutting and frigid as we pick up speed, like razors of ice slashing across my face.

units.rawText: When I have no choice but to narrow my eyes against the wind, my body sinks and we're free of the ground.
units.displayText: When I have no choice but to narrow my eyes against the wind, my body sinks and we're free of the ground.

spans.text: When I have no choice but to narrow my eyes against the wind, my body sinks and we're free of the ground.

units.rawText: It's flying, it's flying! It's really flying!
units.displayText: It's flying, it's flying! It's really flying!

spans.text: It's flying, it's flying! It's really flying!

units.rawText: Woohoo~
units.displayText: Woohoo~

spans.text: Woohoo~

units.rawText: Woohoo~ Hahahahaha!
units.displayText: Woohoo~ Hahahahaha!

spans.text: Woohoo~ Hahahahaha!

units.rawText: Croquette yells in excitement as we sail into the wind and snow, soaring higher and higher into the sky.
units.displayText: Croquette yells in excitement as we sail into the wind and snow, soaring higher and higher into the sky.
